PriceWin Hotel Deal Finder v1.0.0

- Initial release for hotel price comparison.
- Instantly compares live hotel prices across Booking.com, Agoda, Google Hotels, and OpenTravel for any city and travel dates.
- One command returns ranked best-value, cheapest, and quality hotel picks with direct booking links in USD.
- Handles bot-protected cities via built-in Patchright daemon for reliable results.
- Requires only Node.js; no API keys or external configuration needed.
- Strict instructions for single-command use and output formatting to ensure consistent, high-quality responses.
